summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun), extracts it, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` bundled in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line file carrying a rotated string-array constant and character-code string builder (`WV8StW` shuffle over `n7gIxM`; `hc1jfK9` decoder) — its readable content is heavily obfuscated and its declared purpose ("math init") is unrelated to the package's advertised bots SDK function. The result is that `npm install @or-sdk/bots` fetches an alternate JavaScript interpreter and uses it to execute an opaque, bundled payload on the installer's machine, bypassing Node-based static review. The package name and CHANGELOG reference an internal OneReach `@or-sdk/*` scope on `gitlab.internal.onereach.io`, and an install-time obfuscated-payload-under-fetched-runtime pattern is inconsistent with a legitimate first-party SDK release regardless of scope ownership.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
